faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HLL Lifecare Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications for the HLL Lifecare Recruitment 2026 is 26th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names for which HLL Lifecare is recruiting?
faq.answer: HLL Lifecare is recruiting for the posts of Senior Production Assistant (Pharma) and Production Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Senior Production Assistant (Pharma) and Production Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Senior Production Assistant (Pharma)?
faq.answer: For the Senior Production Assistant (Pharma) post, candidates need to have a Diploma in Pharmacy or a B.Sc degree.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 40 years as of 01-08-2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, followed by a Skill Test, and an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Production Assistant post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Production Assistant post is Rs.17793/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for HLL Lifecare Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for these positions?
faq.answer: The job location for these positions is Belagavi, Karnataka.
